title: Review: The Study Log

cells.text: **Level 2 review!** This is a study app's log. Each row is one study session: the student, the subject, how many minutes they studied, and their quiz score afterwards (out of 100). Use everything from Level 2: filtering, several conditions, sorting, new columns and loc. Scroll up to earlier lessons if you get stuck.

cells.prompt: Press Run to load the study log into df.
cells.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv("study_log.csv")
df.head()

cells.prompt: How many sessions lasted 45 minutes or more? Pick one, then press Run.
Show the Math sessions, highest score first.
hints: Filter to Math, then add .sort_values() with ascending=False.

cells.prompt: Show the Economics sessions by Maya or Sam.
hints: Two conditions joined with &, each in round brackets. isin() handles Maya or Sam.

cells.prompt: Add a column points_per_min (score ÷ minutes, rounded to 2 decimals). Then show the sessions where it's above 2.
hints: Line 1: wrap the division in round brackets and add .round(2). Line 2: filter on the new column.

cells.prompt: Using loc, show the student and minutes of the Biology sessions.
Last one: show the student and score columns for the 3 lowest scores, lowest first.
hints: nsmallest gives the lowest rows, already in order. Then pick the 2 columns.

recap: Level 2 done! You can filter with one or several conditions, sort, add new columns and pick with loc and iloc. Next up: summarising data.
